title: CommonsDecisionVerdict
description: The mediated outcome of a decision request. disposition encodes the safety guarantee in the contract itself: a human_required verdict carries no selected option and MUST NOT be auto-applied. Flows from the mediate-decision feature to the apply-decision feature.

disposition.description: auto_apply: a selected option may be delivered to the worker. human_required: the decision is escalated and MUST NOT be auto-applied.

selected_option_id.description: The chosen option id; MUST be one of request.prompt.options[].id when disposition=auto_apply, and null when disposition=human_required.

reason.description: One-line rationale from the coach or the safety gate.

source.description: Who produced the verdict: the coach surface, or the pre-coach safety gate.
